description: This file defines the main app structure for a macOS application called OpenClaw, including its app delegate, main app struct, menu bar item handling, and updater integration. It manages application lifecycle events, status menu interactions, and auxiliary components like onboarding, update checking, and session management.

classes.name: StatusItemMouseHandlerView
classes.description: A transparent NSView subclass that captures mouse events to handle clicks and hover actions on the status item in the menu bar.

classes.name: AppDelegate
classes.description: The application delegate handling app launch, termination, and URL opening events; manages startup routines, onboarding, and shutdown procedures.

methods.name: application(_:open:)
methods.description: Handles opening of URLs and delegates them to DeepLinkHandler.

methods.name: applicationDidFinishLaunching(_)
methods.description: Performs initialization routines after app launch, including duplicate detection, onboarding, remote setup, and auto-open chat feature.

methods.name: applicationWillTerminate(_)
methods.description: Handles cleanup and shutdown routines when the application is terminating.

methods.name: scheduleFirstRunOnboardingIfNeeded()
methods.description: Schedules the onboarding screen to show if the user hasn't seen it yet.

methods.name: isDuplicateInstance()
methods.description: Checks if more than one instance of the app is running.

methods.name: applyStatusItemAppearance(paused:sleeping:)
methods.description: Updates the status item's button appearance based on current app state.

methods.name: applyAttachOnlyOverrideIfNeeded()
methods.description: Handles special launch configurations based on command-line arguments.

methods.name: installStatusItemMouseHandler(for:)
methods.description: Attaches a custom mouse handler view to the status item button for intercepting clicks and hover events.

methods.name: toggleWebChatPanel()
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the web chat panel.

methods.name: statusButtonScreenFrame()
methods.description: Calculates and returns the screen frame of the status button.

methods.name: effectiveIconState
methods.description: Computes the effective icon state based on overrides and activity store.
